releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.22 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* 100% On-Device & Offline: Completely removed Gemini API, cloud network dependencies, and API keys
* Manual Skip Pinning: Interactive 'Pin Target' tool on screenshot gallery allows 1-tap coordinate learning for failed/stubborn ads
* Multi-Stage Live Fallback Escapes: Auto-capture at 8.4s, smart corner probing at 14.4s, and global back escape at 21.6s
* Re-analysis attempt capping at 3 attempts to prevent CPU loops
* Cleaned up Settings UI and verified 100% test pass rate
